agents.name: Domain Analyst
agents.role_line: Traces scoped business behaviour, features and design intent through cited source.

agents.name: Evidence Auditor
agents.role_line: Checks that every claim's citations resolve and records coverage limits and unresolved evidence.

agents.name: Spec Writer
agents.role_line: Drafts cited specification narrative from recovered facts.

agents.name: Gap Triager
agents.role_line: Triages recorded gaps into cited design notes; never fills a gap without evidence.

agents.name: Section Writer
agents.role_line: Drafts one catalogue section as cited claims for review.
